**A smaller one.** Controllers, headphones, SIGIL as a real episode and a
stack of quality-of-life fixes. The bigger work stays in the workshop until
it's ready.

## Controls

**Gamepads and joysticks.** Both sticks, gyro aim, rumble and the Steam Deck,
in both DOOM and Heretic, with their own group: F4 → Controls. Back and Start
together open F4. Rumble follows what you hear: your own weapons are tuned by
hand, everything else shakes by the low end of its sound.

**Everything can be rebound.** Keys, mouse buttons, the wheel and pad buttons,
each action with room for a second key. If you changed your mouse buttons in
an old config, they are back at the defaults: set them again in F4 → Controls.

## Sound

**Headphones.** F4 → Sound → Output: Speakers, Headphones (KEMAR) or
Headphones (KU100). Sounds in the world now pass through a measured dummy head,
from the SADIE II database of the University of York, so in front and
behind you start to mean something. Speakers stay the default. Stereo also
holds still as you turn, and a sound out of sight comes from the opening it
reaches you through.

**Three winds.** Still air, a breeze and a gale are now three different sounds
instead of one wind at three strengths. They are made as they play, so nothing
loops.

## SIGIL

**SIGIL is episode 5.** Load `sigil.wad` and it sits in the episode menu with
its own names, par times and intermission.

**Bloom gives way.** SIGIL lines whole rooms with fire and red rock, and the
bloom turned them into a red smear. It now eases off where the view glows as a
whole, and crowded glowing walls light less. Ordinary views don't change.

## Looks

**Doom's pixels.** The world now draws the 1.2:1 pixels the art was made for,
the same ones the status bar already had. A texel covers the same pixel as the
HUD, walls stand their proper height, and the view keeps its width.

**Real-size bricks.** DOOM's two-metre bricks are laid again at half the size,
cut from their own artwork. F4 → Graphics → Real-size bricks.

**E2's warehouses.** The ceiling panels over the crate rooms now glow softly and
light the room, as bright as the original showed them.

**Things stand on the floor.** Many sprites hung a few pixels into solid floors
and lost their bottom rows. They stand on them now. Liquids still swallow them.

**Steady glow.** Rooms beside nukage no longer pulse as the flat animates, and
bloom no longer flickers while you walk past it.

## New defaults

**Ragdolls and hidden walls.** New players now start with Deaths on
Ragdolls, Hollywood and Skip hidden walls and floors on. If you have already
saved settings, yours stay as they are: F4 → Graphics → Combat → Deaths, and
F4 → Graphics → Performance.

## Faster and fixed

- Damage and pickup flashes stop rebuilding the palette lookup at every step.
- Lights ask only the map lines near them, not all of them.
- Bloom skips the weather for what doesn't glow.
- Rooms that haven't changed stop crossfading their echo into the same echo.
- The classic renderer no longer crashes with the eye exactly on a vertex.

## Thanks

**Liblastic** renamed the F4 label from Graphics to Settings, since it has long
been more than graphics.
